patterns.note: The site employs a minimalist, high-contrast layout with large, full-bleed images as primary content, framed by stark black text on a white background.
Headings are set in a very large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, regular-weight body text.
The UI design is strictly monochromatic, using only black text on a white background, allowing the photography to introduce all color.

The initial full-screen text logo 'PAPER HOUSE PROJECT' scales down and repositions to become a compact 'P H' logo in the top-left corner, while a navigation menu simultaneously appears in the top right, forming a sticky header upon scroll.
Project detail pages feature a dynamic arrangement of large images and text blocks, often with images spanning the full width or presented in an asymmetrical grid alongside descriptive text.

technique_notes: The initial hero experience features a full-screen text element that animates its size and position to transform into a compact, sticky header logo as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections, including large images and accompanying text, are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, maintaining a clean and focused presentation.
The site prioritizes large, high-resolution architectural photography, using it as the dominant visual element, with UI elements serving as a minimal, high-contrast frame.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body text) with a clean, legible body text, creating a strong, editorial feel.
design_tokens.spacing: airy – generous vertical spacing between sections and elements, particularly in the hero and main content areas, contributing to a minimalist and premium feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, full-screen text hero that fluidly transforms into a minimalist sticky header on scroll. This, combined with the stark black-and-white UI framing large, high-quality architectural photography, creates a highly editorial and sophisticated presentation.
